entries.author: Kevin Brown
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv3 without Trophy fitted (1-12 CAV, Poland 2022), left front: hull, turret envelope, CROWS, gun. Trophy itself: see the sep_v2_trophy entries.

entries.author: U.S. Army
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv3 without Trophy, left side, Fort Hood: road wheels, skirts, turret side, bustle rack, CROWS-LP, UAPU box at the rear left. Bushes hide the lower run.

entries.author: U.S. Army USARCENT by Joseph Kumzak
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv3 (caption) with ARAT reactive tiles on skirts and turret, right side, moving; motion blur. No CROWS, pintle M2. ARAT is an add-on, not the base look.

entries.author: Kevin Brown
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv3 without Trophy, head-on with slight right offset: hull front, glacis, mantlet, turret cheeks, CROWS, sights.

entries.author: Sgt. Calab Franklin
entries.note: Turret roof: CROWS-LP on the commander's station being fitted, loader's hatch, gun barrel. SEPv3, Fort Hood 2020.

entries.author: 7th Army  Joint Multinational Training Command from Grafenwoehr, Germany
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv2 with CROWS II, left side, woodland camo; fitted with a mine plow (not part of the model).

entries.author: Spc. Michael Germundson
entries.note: M1A2 SEP with CROWS II (Commons: SEP V2), left front, tan, NTC 2015; low light.

entries.author: Markus Rauchenberger
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv2, close head-on: glacis, mantlet, CPS/sights, CROWS II, loader's hatch.

entries.author: 1st Lt. Henry Chan, 16th Sustainment Brigade, 21st Theater Sustainment Command
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv2 from directly behind on a port apron: hull rear, exhaust grille, bustle rack; ground guide partly blocks the centre.

entries.author: Visual Information Specialist Markus Rauchenberger, U.S. Army
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv2, left rear: engine deck, rear grille, turret bustle and stowage, crew on the roof.

entries.author: Spc. Charles Probst
entries.note: CROWS II on the commander's station with its armour shield, commander's and loader's hatches.

entries.author: U.S. Army USArmyEURAF by Sgt. Evan Ruchotzke
entries.note: Abrams with Trophy (launcher and radar box on the turret side) and ARAT tiles on the right skirt, Germany 2020. Commons files it as SEPv3, but the full-height CROWS II and SEPv2-style headlights point to SEPv2 with Trophy; inferred.

entries.author: U.S. Army USArmyEURAF by Sgt. Evan Ruchotzke
entries.note: Turret side close-up of the same tank: armour boxes on the turret side and bustle, ARAT tile mounting on the skirt, crew for scale.

entries.author: U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Evan Ruchotzke
entries.note: Same Trophy-fitted tank on a transporter, seen from a rear quarter with the gun traversed forward: hull rear, tail lights, bustle, Trophy launchers, rear deck. The trailer hides the lower run.

entries.author: Michał Derela
entries.note: M1A2 SEPv2 at MSPO 2021 with Trophy launcher mock-ups, right side: whole hull and turret. Mock-up launchers; positions match the service fit.

gaps: us_m1_abrams_sep_v3_trophy: no licensable photo of a SEPv3 with Trophy fitted; the SEPv3 entries show the tank without it, and the Trophy launcher and radar come from the sep_v2_trophy entries.
us_m1_abrams_sep_v3_trophy: no three_quarter_rear or rear photo of a SEPv3; the hull rear is shared with SEPv2 except the UAPU box on the left rear (visible in the side view).
us_m1_abrams_sep_v3_trophy: no top view; turret roof from the detail (CROWS-LP) and the front view.
us_m1_abrams_sep_v2: no top view; turret roof from the detail and the three-quarter rear.
us_m1_abrams_sep_v2_trophy: no front, rear or top view; hull matches us_m1_abrams_sep_v2.
all variants: no running-gear close-up; road wheels, sprocket and idler read from the side views.
